label: Applying to a UAE federal university as an international student, autumn 2027

milestones.label: Zayed University confirms its undergraduate application dates
milestones.note: No date. The page carries the line "Application Dates to be confirmed" where the dates belong. Check the page for the dates.

milestones.label: UAEU announces an application period
milestones.note: No date. UAEU says applicants apply through the ministry's portal during announced application periods and publishes no undergraduate period for 2027. Its graduate deadlines are published; its undergraduate ones are not.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: Where the federal universities sit relative to this date is not known, because neither publishes a date to compare it against.

supplementarySteps: Establish first whether you are eligible at all. Places and subsidies at the federal universities are directed at UAE nationals and children of Emirati mothers, and international admission is a separate and much smaller stream.

Write to the named admissions office rather than following the national timetable. Zayed University names an undergraduate admissions address for each of its Abu Dhabi and Dubai campuses; UAEU routes international students and children of UAEU staff through a different page from nationals.
Expect to be asked for an attested transcript, an English test result and, at Zayed, an EmSAT or SAT mathematics score or an internal placement test.

notes: The applicant group on this route is deliberately non-eu rather than any. Every applicant from Denmark, whatever their European passport, is an international applicant here and that is not an administrative detail: the route Emirati school-leavers use is a national placement process, and a foreign applicant cannot use it. Recording one route for both would describe a path this site's readers cannot take.

Neither federal university publishes an undergraduate application deadline for 2027, and the two silences are different: Zayed says the dates are to be confirmed, UAEU says nothing at all. Both are recorded on the Destination with the state that fits.

Not established: whether an international student at a federal university pays a different fee from an Emirati one, and whether the international stream has a quota. Both were looked for and neither is published.
